datasets.name: Radar change Δσ° · 2024-10-20 → 2024-11-01
datasets.citation: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data. Sentinel-1 RTC from Microsoft Planetary Computer (CC BY 4.0); VV, multilooked and resampled by TerraPulse.
datasets.description: Δσ° = σ°(2024-11-01) − σ°(2024-10-20), VV, orbit 110-descending, 3×3 mean. Orange = brighter after (debris, rubble, roughening), blue = darker after (often new standing water). 4.2% of pixels > +3 dB, 5.1% < −3 dB. Caveat: rice fields around L'Albufera are deliberately flooded in autumn/winter, so not all new water in the south is flood water. The radar orbit covers ~68% of the area (southern strip missing).
